@ a flow that only reads the time gives 0 1 2 ... and the calls cut the frames anywhere, 0 frames too
@ two flows that only read the time in one caller read the same number: 101 T, whatever the cuts of the calls
@ a slow output that reads the time reads the frame of its tick, with no modifier on the parents
@ a time-only child and a caller with a stage of its own read the same number: T * 1000 + the frame of the tick
@ a reset makes the next frame the frame 0 for all of them, in the middle of the ticks of sample / 4 too
